members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the list.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: The text shown while nothing is selected.

members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown below the control.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message shown, in place of the description, while the control is invalid.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the control disabled.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks a selection as required.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the control invalid.

members.name: supportingText
members.doc: Text shown beside the count of selected items.

members.name: emptyStateTitle
members.doc: The title shown when no item matches the search.

members.name: emptyStateDescription
members.doc: The message shown when no item matches the search.

members.name: items
members.doc: The items to choose from.

members.name: selectedKeys
members.doc: The selected keys, when the caller controls them; `'all'` selects every item that is not disabled.

members.name: defaultSelectedKeys
members.doc: The keys selected at first, when the control keeps its own selection.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with the new selection each time it changes.

members.name: showSearch
members.doc: Shows the search field in the list.

members.name: showFooter
members.doc: Shows the Reset and Select all buttons below the list.

members.name: onReset
members.doc: Called after Reset clears the selection.

members.name: onSelectAll
members.doc: Called after Select all selects every item.

members.name: selectedCountFormatter
members.doc: Formats the count of selected items shown in the trigger.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Marks the item disabled: it cannot be selected, and Select all skips it.

members.name: textValue
members.doc: The text that search and typeahead match, when the item's content is not plain text.
